name: ISMOS
aliases: Approximate Image-Space Multidirectional Occlusion Shading Model
definition: A unified shading model for volume rendering that simulates different light sources, handles opaque and transparent medium occlusion separately using full and partial occlusion methods, and blends occlusion shadings from multiple layers to produce realistic shading through transparent volumes.
summary: ISMOS is a post-processing shading model for volume rendering that simulates multidirectional lighting and shadows by computing occlusion in image space rather than via projection.
